text: The early readiness harness is one test-scope runner outside the deployed services, run on one SIT environment against WireMock stubs generated from the published contracts of rwb-treatment, rwb-case, rwb-source-data, rwb-decision and rwb-access plus one CCMS or Land Office check fixture, with the contract version of every hop pinned in the report; its seed is two cases placed through the owners' published operations only (one at ROUTE_APPROVED_DIL with its deed-in-lieu treatment, one at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED with its title documents missing), its evidence is one report per story and business date, and its gate is all-green on the three criteria of section 7 with a stub pass reported as a stub pass and never as a real-owner pass.
why: FEAT-TRT-13 names CCMS and the Land Office as the systems of the check and gives no interface detail, the legacy key names no harness at all, and Architecture v5 gives the service contracts but no test environment, seeding set or evidence format, so the harness has to be placed somewhere before the story can be built and the wave can be entered.
read: RWB-E3-013 AC1 to AC4 and its data, endpoint and message tables; FEAT-TRT-13 and FEAT-TRT-12 of the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3; R-DIL-01 and R-SET-22 of the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4; Architecture v5 slides 13, 14, 15, 18, 41 and 44 (service catalogue, P3, P1, P7, P4 and S2 contracts, job map); DP-03, DP-05, DP-13 and DP-19; the ownership map for treatment, case, task, assignment, decision_log_entry, v_ace_collateral, v_ace_collateral_detail and v_ace_npa_asset.
confirm: Integration lead and QA lead, with the tech leads of rwb-treatment (S2) and rwb-case (P3)
impact: If the check is called through a different owner, only the fixture name and one consumed operation change and the criteria, the assertion order and the evidence stay as they are; no business value, table or contract field is affected.
